THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 13.06.2023, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 B.A.No.4411/23 3  ORDER
Petitioners have approached this Court seeking anticipatory bail as they apprehend arrest in connection with the investigation of crime No.375 of 2023 of Changaramkulam Police Station.
Offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 406, 498A r/w Section 34 of IPC.
Crime was registered on the basis of a complaint submitted by the de facto complainant who is the wife of the 1st petitioner.

2. Today when the matter is came up for consideration, learned Public Prosecutor upon instruction submitted that, now the investigation in this case is already completed and a final report has been submitted.
In that final report, only the petitioners 1 to 3 are made as accused Nos.1 to 3.
The petitioners 4, 5 and 6 were already deleted from the list of accused persons.

In such circumstances as the final report is filed, I am of the view that this application can be disposed of clarifying that it shall be open for the petitioners 1 to 3 to appear before the jurisdictional court as and when required.

Sd/-
